composition.serve_who: This sheet (Termodinamica SW 108-01) is the wiring schematic for the Termodinamica VRV18E1 marine air-conditioning system: two VRV18E1 compressor/heat-exchanger units (Port Engine Room and Stbd Engine Room), each with its own seawater cooling pump (TMD100), driving a chain of MRMAXI18i/MRMAXI30i fan-coil "air handler" units (one per named cabin/space) via BUS master/slave lines, plus the touch-screen HMI, AC/DC current sensor, and TMD Bridge/Modbus gateway that let all units be monitored/controlled together. Each fan-coil row is named by cabin (Fwd Guest, Salon port, Aft Guest port, Fwd/Aft Galley, Aft Crew port on the Port row; Aft/Fwd Crew stbd, Aft Guest stbd, Salon stbd, Owner's cabin on the Stbd row), matching register nodes for 590-aircon-fancoil-*. The two VRV18E1 rows map to 590-aircon-compressor-1 (Port) and 590-aircon-compressor-2 (Stbd). Shared BUS/Ethernet/Switch-BUS-Box wiring, cable specs and the touch-screen/PLC-style interconnect details are infrastructure of the 590-aircon-system as a whole, not of any single fancoil.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Row labelled 'VRV18E1 ENGINE ROOM PORT', fed from its own Main Switchboard breaker B1 40A, driving its own Sea Water Pump TMD100 and the entire Port fan-coil BUS chain; matches register node for Aircon Unit 1 (compressor + heat exchanger + seawater cooling pump).

functions.label: Compressor power supply & seawater cooling pump
functions.what_it_does: Supplies 230VAC compressor power from the Port main switchboard to the VRV18E1 Port unit, which in turn powers its own seawater pump (TMD100) for condenser cooling; the unit also grounds to an independent anode/zinc (never to any other device, per warranty note).

flow_scenarios.path: Main Switchboard Port -> Breaker B1 (40A, C or D curve) -> VRV18E1 Engine Room Port (compressor) -> Sea Water Pump TMD100 (fed via power supply cable, 3x1.5mm² L+N+PE) -> seawater cooling of condenser -> overboard/return
Compressor ground wire -> independent anode/zinc ONLY (not shared with any other device) -- failure to isolate invalidates system warranty

facts: Touch Screen Interfaces (Addr.1, one per row, TMD Internet Interface 80W@24VDC) provide the local HMI, fed via Ethernet lan from a shared Internet Router and 'Touch Screen 7' node per row.

Each row terminates its fan-coil chain in an AC/DC Current Sensor TRMS mod.QI-50-V-485 (Addr.31, 5W@24VDC, clamp-on, MAX 50A) feeding a TMD Bridge (Addr.32, 5W@24VDC) which outputs to an RS485 Modbus RTU gateway for external monitoring integration.

A Switch BUS Box Connection sits between the two VRV18E1 units, joining the Port and Stbd BUS master lines together via BUS Slave line loop — this is the shared distribution/interconnect point for the whole aircon BUS network, not a piece of either compressor or fancoil.

BUS cable specs: min 0.5mm² / max 1.0mm² section, 100-120 ohm impedance, 50-60pF/m capacitance, twisted pair ~10 twists/meter; shield/screen grounded only at compressor box side, never at air handler electronic panel; must be routed min. 10cm from AC/DC power wiring, sheathed if possible.
Termodinamica DC power supply cable (24VDC, GND) must run as a single line sourced from the compressor unit or a single point — mixing sources is not allowed.
To enter the Air Handler electronic panel PCB, always use 2x2x0.75mm² wire regardless of run length.

Detail insets (right side of sheet) document component-level rear-view wiring for: SyxthSense Touch Screen, VRV18E1 terminal block, SubSlave Air Handler connection, Air Handler wiring (Master/Slave), Air Handler Port/Stbd connection, Master/Slave Air Handler interlink, TS7E 7" Exor Touch Screen & Dual Touch Screen Interfaces, AC/DC Current Sensor detail, and Switch BUS Box internal wiring — these are wiring-practice references for the same BUS backbone, not separate systems.
